allowed_runtime_components.scope: Python interpreter and standard-library local file/JSON/hash/process operations only
allowed_runtime_components.conditions: Supported security-patched branch; no arbitrary subprocess or network use

allowed_runtime_components.scope: Existing image processing and registration; no external model loading
Local probe/decode/crop/scale/encode/mux/verify; libx264 video, AAC preparation, original audio copy
allowed_runtime_components.conditions: Trusted patched build; actual linked/bundled dependencies and license notices checked

allowed_host_capabilities: Read skill instructions and task-authorized local files
Write task parameters/reports into authorized local directories
View task-local media using the host built-in preview
Read-only lookup of official license/security/version sources without uploading user media or executing retrieved code
forbidden_without_review_and_approval: Invoke unlisted models, libraries, plugins, MCP integrations, services or media applications
Use Python/shell/helper scripts to invoke an unlisted dependency
Modify package scripts, requirements or the allowlist to bypass a stop
Reuse approval from a different user, version, purpose or task without explicit matching scope
extension_required_order: Identify exact tool/version/build/source/purpose and transitive dependencies or weights
Complete license/commercial-use/security review; unresolved means stopped
Present review and alternatives to current user
Obtain explicit user approval for that exact scope
Record approval and actual usage locally before execution
runtime_attestation: Agent records are declarations, not OS-enforced evidence; scripts do not intercept other host tool calls
known_open_security_items: FFmpeg observed at 8.1 in prior audit; patched 8.1.2 or verified backport required for that branch
x264 advisory applicability and build patch status remain unconfirmed

optional_components_owner_approved.approved_by: package owner, 2026-10-30, for the scopes below; each machine still verifies its actual build

components.source: native/ (Rust, standard library only, no crates)
components.build_tool: Rust toolchain (rustc/cargo), build time only; MIT OR Apache-2.0
components.scope: Per-pixel colour conversion, chroma average, blend and paste-back kernels loaded by flow_patch.py via ctypes
components.default: FLOW_KERNELS=auto uses the library only if built in native/target/release and it passes the bit-identical self-check against NumPy; numpy never uses it; native requires it
components.conditions: Built locally from the bundled source; never download or ship prebuilt binaries; results must stay bit-identical to the NumPy paths

components.scope: FLOW_VIDEO_ENCODER for check-only exports; deliverables and Flow uploads only with FLOW_HW_DELIVERABLE=1 after a quality comparison with libx264 on that machine
components.conditions: Encoder present in the verified FFmpeg build; GPU driver from the vendor, its licence reviewed on that machine; report and NOTICE name the encoder

components.scope: scripts/remote_run.py only: one host alias from the user-local profile ~/.claude/flow-patch-local/remote-worker.json; check/push/run/pull inside its task folder; package scripts only; no deletion
components.conditions: BatchMode (no password prompts); profile and machine details stay outside the package; SHA-256 compared after each transfer
